reason: The studio's types union and ASSET_CATEGORIES allowlist could not express or see the friction kind at all.
An existing coverage tool passes the wrong ScriptKind for .tsx sources, silently understating coverage.
An unresolved convention — ADR-NNNN doubling as placeholder and generic pattern token — made a repo-wide substitution rewrite unrelated files.
The build command adopts and then terminates the launching session's presence declaration, a destructive incorrect write by existing tooling.
Spawned builders ended their turn awaiting a notification instead of completing the objective, requiring an orchestrator nudge.
Bare vite boots without the required tsx loader and 500s with an error naming the workspace, a misleading failure from existing tooling.
The proof command exits 0 vacuously for a nonexistent package and the write fence bars any leaf from scaffolding, halting the documented chain.
A .strict() shape behind a deliberately fail-silent writer makes any additive producer field silently switch off persistence with no red.
The brief's negative-existence premise was carried without any mechanism re-checking it against the live store at consumption time.
check:coverage ran and passed 7/7 but validated a test title rather than the contract's clauses, so unasserted clauses read as proven.
The gate's ordering places the cheap claim check after the expensive legs, a bad ordering default in existing tooling that makes recovery cost a full re-run.
check:mirror-conformance registers only one of several mirrors, so the drift check covers only part of the surface it exists to fence.
No claim or mutex mechanism exists for the friction queue, so concurrent adjudicators cannot be fenced at all.
check:corpus-content's per-repo V=0 ceiling attributes sibling live edits to the gating session, a wrong scoping default in an existing check.
An existing command fails to resolve the house @path convention and wholesale-overwrites the prior verdict while reporting success.
The enforcement wall's behaviour is decided by which branch the host machine checkout happens to sit on, a platform/host-provisioning cause.
Node/pnpm resolution from a scratchpad directory outside the workspace fails twice for shell/platform reasons unrelated to repository code.
The delivered sheet and its cells carry no field recording the code state that produced them, so a two-variable comparison is inexpressible as a defect.
renderArcRollup's fixed ordering puts the actionable parked section last, a bad default in existing tooling that makes truncation hide it.
The AUTHOR_TEST phase's 16-turn budget was exhausted twice on an isolatable two-file unit, a bad budget in the existing build command.
The benchmark's stability check ran but validated against a partial activity counter, admitting visually changing frames as stable.
A steering comparative was authored into a parked body with no check performed against two artifacts already in the store.
The arc lifecycle rule reads only the increment log and cannot see chip-carried work, so remaining work is unrepresentable to it.
The check holds both facts at report time but passes on only the staleness, withholding the budget violation the reader needs.
No edge, tag or gate rung exists that can detect a later ADR falsifying an earlier ADR's prescribed build address.
gate:bg's detach silently depends on nothing holding stdout, so a pipe makes the timeout SIGTERM the run with an indistinguishable signature.
The verify check ran but tested the branch diff rather than the promise it claimed to enforce, reporting a broken promise where there was none.
No kind-agnostic or field-agnostic corpus text search exists, so the absence sweep cannot be performed at all.
The non-vacuity guard ran and passed but measures opaque pixels, a quantity no prop change can move, so it validated the wrong thing.
A Linux-CI rmdir race in temp-fixture teardown reds unrelated branches, a platform cause rather than repository code.
capture.mjs hardcodes a steady-state 30s goto budget with no override, a bad default that refuses on any cold worktree.
Bun is installed but absent from the shell PATH on the dev box, making the gate red for machine-environment reasons.
uat run passes the observe runner raw where adopt memoizes it, an existing command re-running an identical deterministic command per leg.
The claude-login probe observes a retired invariant and prescribes a forbidden remedy, a misleading refusal from an existing check.
The rerun comparison ran but validated against git state only, confidently labelling a genuine store-side fix as infrastructure noise.
The instrument ran as a test and passed 9/0 while calling its subject with arguments in the wrong order, publishing plausible wrong numbers.
The mutation rung's closing message offers only two remedies and omits the correct third, steering sessions toward freezing dead code.
The committed reproduce command's default COMMITTED_RUNG points at an asset that does not exist in the repo, 404ing without naming the cause.
check:land-art fails to take its documented skip branch on a fresh worktree, reding the gate regardless of branch content and absent from CI.
A flag interaction breaks the documented --discharged-by exemption and the refusal prescribes minting a second increment for landed work.
